description:
Encode default ticket-level independent review in Beadwork goal/child prompt guidance (not a keyword classifier, not a structured-result gate).

## Background

Default reviewPolicy is `ticket`: parent should launch a review child (`taskType: reviewImplementation`) before closing an implementation ticket. `scope` and `none` are explicit. Parent dispositions findings as fix (blocking), file (nonblocking follow-up), or reject (record why). User can waive a blocking finding in an ordinary turn; no override tokens.

## Files

- prompt.ts additions if not already complete in B-prompt
- tests
- maybe a short parent guideline in minions packet context is already in nudges

If B-prompt already contains this, this issue is the test/proof and any missing reviewPolicy branches (scope/none). Do not duplicate conflicting copy.

## Success criteria

- ticket policy text requires independent review before close.
- scope policy allows close then aggregate review, and states the dependent-start tradeoff.
- none skips independent review children.
- No regex classifier.

## Test plan

- Unit: prompt strings per policy.
- No e2e here (that's D-epic-e2e).
title: Encode ticket/scope/none review policy in goal prompts
